Its only use is the ENTER statement, which 'An implementation of Standard COBOL may include ... or not, at the option of the implementor'; this implementation does not (docs/conformance/9.1/1985-SR-VI.6.12.3-1.md), and 2023 has no ENTER. No program can carry a routine-name, so the row has no witness to give.
